name: predictive.patient.risk
description: Proactively analyze patient data to predict no-shows, deterioration risk, and engagement drop-off. Agents run this on schedule to keep the predictive model fresh.
author: DoctaRx Genesis

steps.name: Gather recent appointment patterns
steps.query: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) as total_appointments, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) as completed, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'no_show' THEN 1 END) as no_shows, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) as cancelled FROM appointments WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY patient_id

steps.name: Calculate risk scores using pattern analysis
